entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集认为智能体是 AI 编程第三阶段的产物：能自己收集上下文、调用工具、调试输出，最终被组织成软件工厂；工程师从敲代码转向治理智能体。

evidence.quote: Before this, I co-founded Lumetric, which was an agent platform for investment teams that we took through Y Combinator and was acquired by Factory.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Your agent's not just coding anymore.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Your agent should be triaging incidents, making plans, creating and updating docs, actually executing the code, reviewing it, testing it, rolling it out, and then monitoring that release.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Let your agent read a sentry alert, pull the traces in other contexts, and then post in Slack.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And as more correct diagnoses roll in and in from the agent, your team can start to build trust and an understanding of this pillar.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Some really common patterns we see are triaging incoming signals like sentry alerts, having the agent make a diagnosis before the human can even answer the page, proactively testing security, scanning for secrets or vulnerabilities,
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And with the agent doing all of this, the human engineer's role shifts to responding, to exercising judgment,
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: At Factory, we have the concept of agent readiness.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Are your dev environments cleanly reproducible such that an agent can use them?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You can start with this agent readiness assessment, but no matter what, your engineers must monitor agent performance and control behavior.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So agent readiness is really a precursor to effective engineering, whether it's an agent or a human that ends up in that system.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 智能体就绪度 (agent readiness)
entities.how_described: Factory 用八个维度评估企业的智能体就绪度：验证护栏、构建文档、测试、文档、可复现的开发环境、模块化代码、可观测性和安全扫描——智能体与人类工程师走同一条路，铺好路双倍有用。

evidence.quote: At Factory, we have the concept of agent readiness.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You can start with this agent readiness assessment, but no matter what, your engineers must monitor agent performance and control behavior.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So agent readiness is really a precursor to effective engineering, whether it's an agent or a human that ends up in that system.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 模型无关 (model agnostic)
entities.how_described: 本集三大原则之一：软件工厂不应锁定单一模型供应商，每个任务用够用的最便宜模型——例如 GPT 5.2 审代码性能与最新 Opus 相同但价格一半，开源替代可便宜 10 到 30 倍。

evidence.quote: First, it should be model agnostic.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 古德哈特定律 (Goodhart's law)
entities.how_described: 本集用它批评公司考核 token 用量：一旦你衡量 token 使用量，工程师就会去优化它，它就不再是好指标；应衡量结果（上线时间、修复时间、人工干预次数）而非 token。

evidence.quote: It's Goodhart's law in real time.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 护栏 (guardrails)
entities.how_described: 本集说智能体时代工程师的职责是保持护栏收紧、捕捉代码漂移、设定方向；智能体处理不了一切，总会有护栏要收紧，人要作为验证关卡站在工厂里。

evidence.quote: So with this, the engineer's role shifts to keeping guardrails tight, catching code drift, and setting the high level priorities and direction.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You can define your guardrails, your agents, your docs, testing policies, really governance just one time, and then standardize it across the organization.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Do you have guardrails like linters and formatters in place?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: There will be guardrails to tighten, code that drifts.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 开源模型 (open source models)
entities.how_described: 本集认为开源模型日益有效，使「押对一匹马」成为伪命题；开源替代方案能把成本砍到便宜 10 到 30 倍，应动态路由、按需选择。

evidence.quote: Well, we think that having to back the right horse is a false choice, especially with the increasing effectiveness of open source models.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
